newsitem.title: PERU: Newmont to list shares in Lima - sources.
newsitem.headline: Newmont to list shares in Lima - sources.

text.p: Newmont Mining Corp, which operates South America's largest gold mine, Yanacocha, in Peru, will list its shares on the Lima Stock Exchange within the next few weeks, bolsa sources said Wednesday.

"The Stocks and Securities Board (CONASEV) has already studied the case and soon there will be the official register of the shares," said a CONASEV source, specifying this would happen in the next few weeks.
He added that Newmont's shares would trade 72 hours after the register.
Last year, Newmont announced it hoped to list its shares in May 1996 on the Lima market, but the sources gave no explanation for the delay.
Newmont officials have said the firm's large presence in Peru through Yanacocha, which had reserves last year of six million ounces of gold, justify listing its shares in the country.
Newmont has a 51.35 percent stake in Yanacocha, a joint venture with local firm Cia. Minera Buenaventura SA, which has a 43.65 percent stake.
